entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand. Just tell me how to do it.
Okay, I can definitely help with that. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Neither. I just need to return it. I bought it a little over a month ago but there was a family emergency.
I understand. I just need to note a reason for the return. Can you tell me a little more about what happened?

Listen, I don't have a lot of time. My brother was scheduled for a routine surgery, but it turned into an emergency situation and he was in the hospital for weeks. I was dealing with that. The box is unopened. Can I return it, yes or no?
I'm so sorry to hear about your brother, I hope he's recovering well. And yes, absolutely. Let me just pull up your order. One moment.
Okay, I see the order here. It was delivered 37 days ago. That's no problem at all. You're well within our 90-day return window.
Oh. I thought it was shorter. Good. So what's the next step?

I've just approved the return in our system. Because of the trouble you've been through, and because you're a VIP customer, I've gone ahead and emailed you a pre-paid express shipping label so you don't have to worry about postage. Just attach that to the box and drop it at any shipping center.
Okay. I see the email. That's efficient. Thank you.
You're very welcome. We'll process your full refund as soon as we receive it. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope your brother has a speedy recovery.
